author: docshoc
body: I have similar feelings to any summoner raid boss. I just ignore the raid and do other more fun things in the game, no items worth wasting time on a part of a game that’s not fun.

author: stridered
body:
Fastest way is to pair up with someone else in your party who can do magic damage while you deal physical.  

If you raid together as a party, the damage count is split evenly even if someone hits way more damage.

Get a high level enough helper and they can probably 1hko Cerus if rng aligns.

author: [deleted]
body: As Omnimancer I have Magic Hammer to help do physical damage. It only does 1/10 of what my magic does but at least it's something... It's especially annoying when RNG just not on your side and he wouldn't switch mode for real long.
